name: MiniMax H3 Image
notes: MiniMax's text-to-image and edit model: its own image model and image VAE, with the same Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder as H3 video.
Settings: 6 steps, cfg 1, euler / simple, no shift node. The model samples on its own fixed 6-step sigma grid.
Made for big pictures: 4 to 20 MP, best around 16 MP. Below 4 MP it gets weak. Sizes in multiples of 32.
Edits: MiniMax H3 Image Conditioning takes the prompt and reference pictures (<Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, ...). image_1 is the picture it edits.
Keep int(steps / denoise) at 6. Anything else lands off the sigma grid and faces turn to mush (low-denoise detailers and img2img included).
LC Speed Boost (grow at step 4) works: 6 s instead of 8 s at 7.5 MP on a 5090.

variants.note: Comfy: does not need a Blackwell GPU

source: Hugging Face tree API sizes (Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image, Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3), ComfyUI 0.45 source (MiniMaxH3Image, nodes_minimax_h3.py) and the image_minimax_h3_image templates, 2026-11-10. Tested 2026-11-10 on the 5090 (int8 + Qwen3-VL bf16): 6 steps at 2688x3360 8 s warm, Speed Boost grow 4 6 s; reference edit at 1600x1984 20 s with the text encoder.
